overview_description.description: Windwalk Games is building the next generation of social games. Their first game is Enemy on Board. Enemy on Board is an online multiplayer game that combines the "hidden roles" gameplay of Mafia or Werewolf with exciting real-time combat. 6 crew members wake up on the spaceship Andromeda; 2 of these crew are secretly aliens in disguise as humans.

product.name: Community Strategy Development
product.description: A service to analyze client goals and create tailored community development plans for digital platforms like Discord.

product.name: Community Building and Design
product.description: A service to design and develop digital communities tailored to client needs, focusing on structure and engagement.

product.name: Community Growth Techniques
product.description: Techniques and methods to scale and grow digital communities based on their unique needs and characteristics.

product.name: Community Operations and Management
product.description: Ongoing management services including moderation, measurement, and operational support for digital communities.

product.name: Community Gamification and Engagement
product.description: Implementation of reward systems, mini-games, and live events to increase community interaction and loyalty.

product.name: Community Amplification and Partnerships
product.description: Services to increase community reach through referral programs, social amplification, and partnerships with relevant online groups.
